integrity: The infinite formula is proved symbolically from the published endomorphism classification. Direct finite enumeration at moduli \(9,27,25,49\) is used only as a reproducibility cross-check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for odd prime powers with \(e\ge2\); powers of \(2\) and isomorphism types of retract images are not classified.
title: Exact retractions of the multiplicative monoid modulo an odd prime power
